steps.content: As the temperature drops day by day, the mech is finally about to be finished.
After working hard for the day, you sit again by the campfire, the warm glow of the fire illuminating her face.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I've thought about it for a long time, you said you can't imagine what the "future" looks like.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I, however, daydream about the future quite a lot. It's kinda amazing. Would you like to hear it?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Consider it... a silly fantasy of a child.
Sitting next to you, Vanilla nods with a smile.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: In my future... the expedition team successfully completed their mission and saved humanity.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: We've found a way to deal with the disasters. Civilization has a chance to be rebuilt.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: That sounds great.
Vanilla smiles. You don't know if she's really imagining the scene you're describing or just agreeing with you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The disaster of the DisSea disappeared, and people rebuilt a city here.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: A city? I've always lived in the outpost, I've never been to one.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: What does a city look like?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It's enormous. It covers dozens of kilometers.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: From the outskirts of the DisSea, to your former outpost—it's all part of this city.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: We live there with many, many people... It will become the largest city in the world.
Vanilla listens, then ponders for a long time.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: ...The largest city outside the DisSea? In this pollution?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Is it hard to imagine?

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: It is. Even Keylan, our daydreamer, would be taken aback to hear these things.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: ...But you talked about it with such passion, and gave so many vivid details. You must have spent a long time imagining that future.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: You make it sound like it'll really happen.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: Humanity is saved, and civilization grows once again... Everyone in the expedition team would love to see that... Yes, they definitely will.
Vanilla pauses, smiling but looks slightly apologetic.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: Me too, I guess... I'm not sure.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That's okay.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Just like how you can't imagine the future I talked about in this short amount of time, it took me a long time to understand your "unchanging" life and scenery.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Change always takes time. It's just that some changes take longer than others.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Even if everything else in the temporal storm hasn't changed, you've already changed.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: What do you mean?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You joined the expedition team and came here.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If you had stayed at that outpost, I wouldn't have met you.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: I'm not like them. They're... people who believe they can change the future. That's something I never imagined myself doing. I'm not that kind of person.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: ...I just couldn't refuse them when they invited me.
She speaks calmly, but a genuine smile appears on her face.

steps.speaker: Vanilla
steps.content: But maybe change is about going with the flow sometimes. Who knows?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: There's one thing I hope will never change.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I want to be with you all forever, including going to the future.
